rawCommits.subject: fix(sessions): keep new chat highlighted across optimistic→real swap
rawCommits.body:
After SessionReady, `useNewSessionUrlSync` did two things in sequence:

  1. `optimisticRow.swap(<real-id>)` — synchronously rewrote the
     `optimistic:<uuid>` row in `sessionsBySurface` to the
     server-assigned UUID via Zustand `setState`.
  2. `setSearchParams({ session: <real-id> })` — queued a React
     Router navigate.

`SessionsList`'s `effectiveSelectedSessionId` only had two cases — URL
session, or fall back to the optimistic row. The window between those
two writes (and any subsequent render where the router state hadn't
propagated through `useSearchParams` yet — back/forward, suspended tab,
etc.) had neither: the row was no longer `optimistic:` and `?session=`
hadn't landed, so the just-created session visibly appeared at the top
of the list with its server-generated title but read as unselected.
The user reported this as "after sending message in new session, still
does not select it in the css".

Add a third fallback: when the URL has no `?session=` and no optimistic
row exists, highlight `titledRows[0]` — the newest row in the surface.
The surfaces are stored in `sortSessionsDesc` order from
`loadAgentSessions` / `loadProjectSessions`, and `addOptimisticSession`
stamps `started_at` at insert time, so the just-swapped real-id row
always sorts to the top across the swap window. Pre-swap, the
optimistic branch still wins; once the URL settles, the explicit
`selectedSessionId` branch wins again.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: keep new chat highlighted across optimistic→real swap

rawCommits.subject: feat(swarm): auto-recover once on initial-provision failure and surface swarm error
rawCommits.body:
When a brand-new remote agent's background readiness wait timed out or
saw `state: error`, the only effect was a `warn!` in the desktop log:
the agent stayed in `provisioning`, the UI sat indefinitely on
"Starting up...", and the user had to manually click Recovery (often
not even knowing the agent was stuck). The cause string supplied by
aura-swarm (e.g. an `Unschedulable` PodScheduled message) was also
dropped because `SwarmAgentStateResponse` only deserialized `state`,
so any error event the gateway emitted was reduced to a generic
"entered error state".

Changes:

- Widen `SwarmAgentStateResponse` to include `error_message` and
  carry the optional reason through `SwarmAgentReadyError::ErrorState`
  and `PollOutcome::Errored`.
- Replace the inert `warn!()` branches in `spawn_swarm_readiness_check`
  with `auto_recover_after_initial_failure`, which broadcasts an
  `auto_recover/starting` event, runs the existing
  `recover_remote_agent_pipeline` exactly once, and on failure
  broadcasts a terminal `state: "error", phase: "startup_failed"`
  carrying both the original swarm reason and the recovery error so
  the StatusCard exits the indeterminate provisioning state and shows
  the manual Recovery action.
- Update `handle_recovery_readiness_error` to embed the swarm-supplied
  reason in both the broadcast banner and the `ApiError`, so the
  manual Recovery click also surfaces the descriptive cause.
- Pass enough context (cloned `AppState`, `Arc<NetworkClient>`,
  `NetworkAgent`) through `BackgroundReadinessTask` to invoke recovery
  from the spawned task.
- Add `starting` and `startup_failed` entries to the StatusCard
  `PHASE_NOTICES` so the UI labels match the new broadcast phases.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
rawCommits.cleanSubject: auto-recover once on initial-provision failure and surface swarm error

rawCommits.subject: feat(agent-picker): add Standard Agent handler to selector data hook
rawCommits.body:
Wire `handleSelectStandard` inside `useAgentSelectorData`. It calls
`api.createGeneralAgentInstance(projectId)` (the same backend hop the
project-row '+' used to fire directly) and routes the resulting
`AgentInstance` through the existing `onCreated` callback so the

Also export `STANDARD_AGENT_CREATING_KEY`, the sentinel the next step

rawCommits.subject: feat(agent-picker): add searchable AgentSelectorList with keyboard nav
rawCommits.body:
New `AgentSelectorList` component renders the Telegram-style picker
the next step will mount inside `AgentSelectorModal`. The list shows a
'Standard Agent' row at the top followed by every saved fleet agent,
filtered live by the search query (case-insensitive over name + role).

Keyboard model mirrors `SlashCommandMenu`:
- Up/Down move the active highlight, wrapping at the edges
- Enter activates the highlighted row
- Escape calls the supplied `onCancel`
- Mouse hover updates the active index
- Rows fire on `mouseDown` with `preventDefault` so the search input
  keeps focus when a row is clicked

The component is purely presentational; it forwards a ref so the
parent modal can hand it the focus target via `Modal.initialFocusRef`.
Per-row `creating` state shows a spinner on the row mid-create and
disables every row to prevent double-fires.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

rawCommits.subject: feat(agent-picker): swap selector modal body for searchable list
rawCommits.body:
Replace the grid-of-cards layout with the new `AgentSelectorList`,

The `+ Create New Agent` footer (and the `AgentEditorModal` it opened)

the project-row '+' used to call directly, so a generic agent can be

agent authoring still lives in the Agents app.

The modal still scopes mobile to remote agents and still hides agents
already attached to this project, matching prior behavior.

rawCommits.subject: test(agent-picker): cover the new picker behavior end to end
rawCommits.body:
Rewrite `AgentSelectorModal.test.tsx` for the searchable list. New
assertions cover:
- the Standard Agent row appears at index 0 alongside the search input
- mobile filters out local agents and uses the 'Add agent' drawer title
- already-attached agents are filtered out
- the search query filters the list and the Standard row drops out
  when it doesn't match
- ArrowDown + Enter activates the highlighted row (real agent path)
- Enter without navigation activates the Standard row
- mouseDown on the Standard row fires `handleSelectStandard`
- a `creating` value disables every option

Update `useProjectListActions` test for the new `+` flow: the hook
now just sets `agentSelectorProjectId` instead of firing
`createGeneralAgentInstance` directly.

Drop the stale `creatingGeneralAgentProjectIds: []` field from the
shared mocks in `ProjectList`, `ProjectsNav`, and `TasksProjectList`
test files now that the hook no longer exposes it.

Also harden the list against jsdom's missing `scrollIntoView` (and
older webviews) so the `useEffect` that pins the active row into view
is a no-op when the DOM doesn't implement the API.

Commit 442fd8a widened the CEO empty-bundle repair into a blanket
"empty -> full_access" rule across normalized_for_identity, the
create-agent UI, and the in-process agent fallbacks, so every agent
shipped with all capabilities turned on. Drop the blanket promotion

rawCommits.subject: fix(installer): un.-prefix MUI_CUSTOMFUNCTION_UNGUIINIT callback
rawCommits.body:
makensis aborted while expanding MUI_LANGUAGE -> MUI_UNFUNCTION_GUIINIT
because the uninstaller's GUI-init callback (AuraUnOnGUIInit) was
emitted as a Call inside the uninstaller section, which NSIS rejects
unless the target function name starts with "un.". Renamed
AuraUnOnGUIInit -> un.AuraOnGUIInit at both the !define and the Function
declaration, and documented the constraint inline so it doesn't regress.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

rendered.title: Searchable agent picker, stuck-provision recovery, and Windows installer fixes
rendered.intro: Today's nightly rebuilds the Add Agent flow around a Telegram-style searchable picker, teaches remote agent provisioning to self-heal when the first pod gets stuck, and clears two Windows installer regressions. A handful of sidebar and chat fixes round out the day, alongside a permissions correction that stops shipping every new agent with full access.

entries.title: New chat row stays selected after the optimistic→real swap
entries.summary: Closes a UI gap where a just-created chat looked unselected during the window between renaming the optimistic row and the URL updating.

items.text: SessionsList now falls back to the newest row when the URL has no ?session= and no optimistic row exists, so a freshly created chat stays highlighted across the optimistic→real id swap (back/forward and suspended tab cases included).

entries.title: Themed installer bitmaps staged correctly on Windows
entries.summary: Fixes the NSIS installer's light/dark bitmap handling and extends the dark title bar treatment to the uninstaller.

items.text: Dark and light header/sidebar bitmaps are now staged directly into $PLUGINSDIR so .onInit no longer writes to root-relative paths, and light-mode header swap happens at GUI init.
Light-bitmap path derivation now fails the build with a clear preprocessor error if the source bitmaps don't end in -dark.bmp, and the dark title-bar DWM hook is applied to the uninstaller as well.

entries.title: Telegram-style Add Agent picker and self-healing remote provisioning
entries.summary: Replaces the Add Agent grid with a searchable, keyboard-driven list and makes a stuck remote-agent startup recover itself once before surfacing the real cause.

items.text: Remote agents whose initial readiness wait times out or errors now trigger one automatic recovery pass instead of stranding the UI on 'Starting up...'; the swarm-supplied reason (e.g. Unschedulable) is carried through to the StatusCard banner and the manual Recovery error, with new starting and startup_failed phases wired into PHASE_NOTICES.

The project row '+' and the right-click 'Add Agent' menu now both open a single AgentSelectorModal whose body is a searchable list: an autofocused search input filters live over name and role, a Standard Agent row sits at the top, and Up/Down + Enter activate rows with the selection scrolled into view.

The picker drops the old '+ Create New Agent' footer and AgentEditorModal detour — pressing Enter on the Standard row hits the same default-create endpoint the project '+' used to fire, spawning a generic agent without leaving the modal. Custom agent authoring still lives in the Agents app.

Picker styling is rebuilt as a Telegram-contacts row layout with hover/active states, a 360px scrollable list on desktop, and larger touch targets inside the mobile Drawer; end-to-end tests cover search filtering, keyboard activation, mobile remote-only filtering, and disabled rows during creation.

entries.title: Permissions default narrowed and several sidebar/chat fixes
entries.summary: Walks back a regression that gave every new agent full access, plus a cluster of smaller fixes around chat errors, modal responsiveness, and project navigation.

items.text: Only the CEO agent now defaults to the full-access preset; regular agents keep an empty permissions bundle and must opt into capabilities from the Permissions tab, reversing the blanket empty→full_access promotion that had shipped every agent with everything turned on.

The Add Agent modal no longer gets stuck: Close and Escape always work, and the Create button is only disabled during an active API call rather than by a stale transition flag from a previous creation.

Chat surfaces a helpful error when an agent isn't assigned to a project instead of failing silently, and the sidebar now auto-expands the project tree to reveal the active agent when navigating in from elsewhere.
Session rows show their project name when the list spans multiple projects, making cross-project session lists easier to scan.

entries.title: Uninstaller GUI-init callback unblocks Windows builds
entries.summary: Restores Windows installer builds after the previous uninstaller dark-title-bar hook tripped an NSIS naming rule.

items.text: Renamed the uninstaller GUI-init callback to un.AuraOnGUIInit so makensis stops aborting when expanding MUI_LANGUAGE → MUI_UNFUNCTION_GUIINIT; the 'un.' prefix requirement is documented inline to prevent regressions.

highlights: Searchable Add Agent picker with keyboard nav
Remote agents auto-recover from failed first provision
Windows installer themed bitmaps and uninstaller fixed
Full-access default rolled back to CEO only
